title: Concept: X-B3-TraceId exposes internal tracing identifiers
description: Publishing a B3 trace id tells an anonymous caller which tracing stack sits behind the endpoint and gives a key that internal dashboards and log searches accept. The identifier outlives the request it names.
applicability: Responses from services instrumented with Zipkin B3 propagation.
risk: An attacker correlates responses across tenants and guesses dashboard or log-search URLs that key on the trace id, turning a debugging convenience into an entry point for internal tooling.
